{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Convert the string to a float
# The string has commas as thousand separators, so we need to remove them
# The string also has a period as decimal separator
# Convert the string to float
# First, remove any commas and convert to float
total_revenue_completed_float = float(total_revenue_completed.replace(',', ''))

# Print the result
total_revenue_completed_float"}
